answer: By establishing a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function on staking collateral, the network bounds the entry of Sybil identities, relegating the adversary to a localized subgraph. A sparse cut acts as an inlet, through which trust decay diminishes propagation to the honest oasis, as the spectral transition matrix penalizes rapid traversal. Slashing penalties drive the expected utility of deception to its nadir, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium where honest consensus asymptotically converges.
